summary: Iter67 (per-person breakdown, unified concepts editor, lodging occupancy table, tooltips). BACKEND: unit tests test_iteration67_per_person.py 12/12 pass; new E2E API suite test_iteration67_e2e_api.py 13/13 pass — cases A–E EXACT in BOTH 'personalizado' and 'servicios' (a la carta with services=[]), using TEST_ clients for directo/agencia/mayorista/operador with pricing_config temporarily 0.80/0.10/0.15/0.15 (restored to 0.75/0/0.12/0.15/0.2, verified). Public link JSON has per_person_breakdown rows+note; internal & public PDF render, contain 'Precio por persona en ocupación Doble: $6,130.00 MXN (2 personas)' and the note. PATCH custom_items (rooms 1→2, pax 8) recomputes total + breakdown (note '8 personas'). Paquete regression: totals identical with/without occupancy_rows (historic engine). FRONTEND: Personalizado flow (Caso B agencia via UI) — unit select only Por noche/Por estancia, check-in/out prefilled from program dates, nights=5 auto, occupancy table add row, total persons 6, pax-sync button works and disappears, formulas exact ('Doble: 1 hab × 2 pax = 2 pers × $875 MXN (neto $700 MXN) × 5 noches = $8,750 MXN'), commission line on public concepts, review total $33,280 = backend; detail shows per-person-breakdown/pp-row-doble/pp-formula-doble/pp-note with exact values. Category change keeps unit (tour per_vehicle → traslado keeps per_vehicle; →hospedaje corrects to per_night; per_stay→extra becomes per_group). A la carta (Caso E per_stay directo) with only custom concepts → $34,450 FE = BE, breakdown exact. Edit flow of custom quotation via UI recomputes (FE $42,840 = BE). Public page /q/:token shows clean per-person rows, Total and public-pp-note, no per-person formulas. Tooltips present in concepts and Settings, hover text displayed. Paquete: concepts editor shows legacy hospedaje (concept-ocupacion-N, no table). One FE/BE mismatch found in Paquete hospedaje concept with qty=0 (pre-existing, see issues).

minor.issue: per_person_breakdown.rows[].components (per-concept per-person amounts, e.g. Hotel $4,375 / Vehiculo $900) is returned in the public payload though not rendered. Not a formula leak per se, but internal composition is exposed to the client via API; consider stripping 'components' in public serializer/PDF context.

Backend honors client.commission_rate override (routes/quotations.py:51) but frontend builders (CustomQuotationBuilder.jsx:128-131, QuotationBuilder.jsx:120) use only global channel commission → review totals/formula commission line would differ from saved total for clients with override.

ui_bugs.component: Paquete armado > Servicios step > hospedaje concept (engine 'package')
ui_bugs.issue: FE estimate ≠ backend when qty=0: conceptMath.conceptQty uses defaultQty(per_night)=trip nights (3) → formula '$1,000 MXN (neto $800) × 3 noches = $3,000' and review total $26,250, but backend historic engine (pricing._price_custom_item custom_engine=False, hospedaje qty default 1, nights multiply only when it.nights>0) saves $1,000 → total $24,250. Pre-existing (old QuotationBuilder customDefaultQty did the same) but now more visible with formula. Fix: in conceptQty, for engine==='package' && category==='hospedaje' use q>0?q:1 (or make backend use nights default). Package totals must not change, so fix the FE side.

issues: money() uses toLocaleString('es-MX') without minimumFractionDigits → '$5,792.5 MXN' (should be $5,792.50); PDF formats correctly
'Habitaciones / Pax' shows '8 adultos · 0 menores ()' with empty parentheses when rooms=[]
Ejemplo panel shows '$ 9500' / '$9500' without thousands separator and inconsistent spacing; Fórmula base helper text example says '0.76 ⇒ margen del 24%' (static) while divisor is 0.80

HelpTip is hover-only (Radix Tooltip) — not reachable on touch devices.
QuotationBuilder.jsx is 1018 lines (>700) — consider splitting steps into modules.

rca of the issue: Paquete hospedaje mismatch: frontend conceptMath.conceptQty (non-custom engine) falls back to defaultQty(unit) → per_night = nights; backend _price_custom_item custom_engine=False treats hospedaje qty default as 1 and only multiplies by ci.nights if >0 (new package concepts send nights=0). Repro: Paquete GDL, 1 doble, add hospedaje neto 800 qty 0 → review $26,250 vs saved $24,250.
